children: India's central bank returned to the market with dollar sales near the open on Wednesday, two traders and an FX broker said, cushioning the rupee from the impact of a spike in oil prices.
opened higher at 94.89 to the dollar, versus 94.95 on Tuesday, defying expectations of a weaker start beyond the 95 level.
